reviews.text: I recently had one of my dogs in at the Bell Rd location for an urgent appointment. Alejandra who was at the front desk was very friendly and helpful throughout the entire appointment. Rain was the tech who assisted Dr Cal with my dog that day and she helped me with an issue from another location and completely resolved it. Dr Cal is also wonderful. I wanted to share my positive experience to make sure Dr Cal, Alejandra and Rain know how much they are appreciated by this grateful pet owner!
Took good care of my daughters dog, did thorough exam and testing and clear plan of action. Dog made full recovery

The team at ArkVets have been so helpful in keeping my older kitties healthy, and helping us manage my eldest's UTI and kidney disease. They are quick to communicate, have a very helpful monthly membership that covers/discounts a lot of the costs, and you can tell they are genuine animal people (like they don't label themselves cat OR dog people... you know the type! They are both)! Dr. Cal and his team at the Bell location were amazing, would highly recommend them!
Thank you!

Really great first experience here in an acute situation with my older pup. Great customer service and everyone was so friendly. Everyone was also very knowledgeable; the vet tech was so knowledgeable and helpful too and I appreciated all their insight and suggestions. Thinking about switching my vet to this vet, even though I initially came for an urgent care/acute reason!!!

I came here because my blizzard needed her teeth examined. She ended up needing one pulled and two sealed. She also got some bloodwork done and a booster vaccine. Rain was so helpful and informative during the process and also very sweet with my baby. Both Rain and Dr. Cal did a fantastic job with blizzard. Her teeth look beautiful. Very happy with their work. Also, very appreciative of their ability to explain the procedure process /aftercare in such a simple way and also empathize with any of my worries.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I cannot say enough wonderful things about ArkVets and the care they have provided for Kona. The entire team has been incredibly kind and welcoming, but I especially want to recognize Dr. Cal and Kayla for the exceptional support and care they have given us throughout Kona’s post-surgery recovery.

ArkVets took over Kona’s care after a post-surgical issue from a previous veterinary practice had not been properly resolved, and we were understandably worried and frustrated. What impressed me most was that ArkVets didn’t simply pick up where the previous care left off — they took the time to thoroughly assess the situation, listen to our concerns, and develop a thoughtful plan to get Kona back on track.

At our first appointment, Dr. Cal spent a considerable amount of time with us talking through everything — what had happened, where things stood, what the plan was, and what we could expect during Kona’s recovery. I never felt rushed, dismissed, or like I was overreacting. In fact, my concerns and the anxiety I had throughout the process were completely validated, which meant so much during an already stressful situation.

Dr. Cal also introduced treatment options that had never previously been offered to us, including laser therapy as an additional option to support Kona’s recovery. I really appreciated the willingness to think beyond what had already been tried and to consider the whole picture.

And the support didn’t end after that first appointment. The follow-up and communication from Kayla and Dr. Cal have been outstanding. They both have been incredibly responsive, concise, supportive, and attentive throughout the process. I have never felt like I was left wondering what was happening or whether my concerns were being heard.

Most importantly, Kona is doing so much better. ArkVets took a situation that had been mishandled and stressful and gave us a clear path forward — and, most importantly, helped get my girl feeling better.

As a pet parent, finding a veterinary team that is knowledgeable is important. Finding one that also listens, validates your concerns, communicates clearly, follows up, explores options, and genuinely takes ownership of your pet’s care is something special.

I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Cal, Kayla, and the entire ArkVets team. They have absolutely earned my trust and my highest recommendation. 🐾❤️

I had a great experience with Paulie today I came in and she was very informative, professional, and listened thoroughly with what I needed. She is one of the best Front desk vets I ever experienced. Shoutout to Paulie she deserves a raise promotion and acknowledgment of all she does at Ark Vets. God bless this establishment and it is covered by the blood of Jesus Amen!

I brought in my 3 year old pup bc she had a non productive cough and was not acting her usual energetic self. They ran blood work, noticed her WBC count was elevated and did X-rays which showed she had a lot of gunk in her lungs & assumed it was pneumonia. Not sure if they checked for valley fever, I was not told anything about it besides that it could be something to consider.

So they kept her a few hours, gave her fluids, gave her oxygen and antibiotics. When I picked her up, it was closing time & they seemed super rushed to get everyone out and did not explain fully what they did in there aside from the above. That night I picked her up I knew something was off. My baby girl breathing worsened, she was breathing quick shallow breathes and stayed that way for the next couple days until she passed @ 2am 8/6/2026.

Staff was nice, but I think the vet Dr. Cal should have checked for valley fever or other things aside pneumonia bc my puppy came back worse then how I left her that fateful Monday 8/3/2026.

I’m not a vet so I put my trust into them, & I do not believe they treated my 3 years old accurately. They were nice overall.

Brought my pup in after she cut her leg and the whole team worked so fast to help her! Dr Cal and Kayla quickly assessed her injury and stapled her right up. 10/10 will go to this hospital for all my urgent needs!

Sharon and I were treated so well that we became calm. Roxy was examined and treated
Kindly and gently!! We feel
fortunate to have met Arkvet, Dr Cal and Jennifer
Jennifer made me elated with how well she handled my Pitbull mix. I was told by other vets that she needed sedation to be examined when she’s just a scared, vocal girly sometimes lol

We recently moved to AZ and found this vet on Google so we gave them a try. They have been great to work with so far and transparent about pricing. Jennifer is great and helps keep my anxious herd dog more calm. Dr Rian is thorough and takes the time to answer questions or explain things if needed.
Our favorite for our pets.  Dr. Cal is our "go to" but any veterinarian there that we have seen has been Uber competent. Staff is caring and wonderful.  We love them.

Cat euthanasia $460 no add ons
$1000 for cremation and pawprint

Seriously can’t praise the staff here enough! Especially Jennifer!!! I was a last minute appointment for my 14 year old boxer, they treated me like family and took amazing care of my senior pup! They were very quick, knowledgeable and super helpful to my specific situation. If I could give 10 stars I would, thank you guys so much!

We had an emergency with our dog and had to make quick, life-saving decisions. We had our hearts set on breeding her and Dr. Cal explored all options with us, giving us honest feedback with each choice. In the end, we did the surgery and that was the best decision. She recovered very quickly. My interactions with Rian were also incredibly positive! She offered great advice with cost effective options. All the vet techs are very professional and compassionate. We found this clinic at the perfect time and they saved the day when we needed it the most!

From the friendly voice making my appointment to the other friendly voice saying they had an earlier appointment if I wanted it. The vet & staff were great! Life is expensive these days it seems & our dog needed quite a few things looked at. So, I am not sure if they are expensive or competitive with prices. Will use them again for sure!
Thank you!

I’ve had nothing but great Experiences with our Vet. Dr. Ryan and Dr. Haley both very sweet with my old dog. Khloe ❤️ And knowledgeable I appreciate them. I never have a problem getting in the day of issues.
Nice facility

I was able to get my puppy scheduled the very next day, which was such a relief! The staff was super friendly, welcoming, and made us feel comfortable right away during his first vet visit. They also offer weekend and late evening appointments which is a HUGE win for busy schedules. Definitely happy with our experience and excited to continue bringing my puppy here!

It was Friday afternoon and my 9-year old Pitbull let out a squeal when I helped her up to get into my car.  I knew immediately something was wrong.

I rushed her to ArkVets on Bell Rd., recommended by her regular doctor who could not see her that afternoon.  I was met by a young lady at the front desk who asked me all the right questions which led me to believe these people knew their stuff.  She brought me into a room right away where I met Jake who immediately x-rayed her and then soon after we met Dr. Calugcugan (Dr. Cal).  He did a series of test in the next two days and arrived at the fact emergency surgery was required.  There was a mass on the spleen and it was oozing blood. Jennifer, Rain, Cuong (techs) helped set her up for surgery along with Maghi.  They were so sweet with my pet.  For the first time ever, I noticed my pet was not trembling.  It was as if she was with friends.

After 3 nail-biting hours of surgery, we got the call--surgery was a success!  Splenic Hematoma was the diagnosis.  The spleen and tumor had been removed.  We picked her up Saturday afternoon and she was walking and in good spirits.

The entire team, including the ladies at the front desk, all were sweethearts.  I must say I didn't expect this from an urgent care.  In fact, my mother was so impressed with the level of care and compassion that she only wished Dr. Cal could be her regular doctor.  Dr. Cal was extremely knowledgeable and was persistent--he kept running tests until he pin-pointed the problem.

We prayed before we headed to their office to check it out as we had decided that if the care was below par, we'd leave and head out to try another ER.  We felt God lead us there!  We have no doubt!

Thank you ArkVet team!  You guys were heaven-sent! Blessings to you all!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Best veterinary care ever! Dr. Calugcugan, Jennifer, and Jake are all stars! Super kind empathetic and professional care for our dog Dolly

The tech, Jennifer was so friendly and professional.  She was exceptional at handling our dog Muffin with great care.  All who I dealt with there were courteous and professional. I recommend them highly.
Dr. Cal, Dr. Burgart and Kayla all did an amazing job start to finish with my dogs dental exam, extraction and post op check up! Thankful for the great team at ArkVets!

Made an appointment for my dog got there they were already really rude and then after I got there they had already diagnosed my dog before I got there telling me his gums were very pale and that he probably had parvo and a parvo test was required mind you my dog is an Esa dog they tell me it was a $200 charge for the parvo and that I could do a partial payment but then proceeded to tell me that I still owe $200 and then I was like well then that's not a partial payment it's the whole thing which made no sense to me we're very rude to me when I said that I only had so much to spend and told me I should just take my dog to the pound and drop him off there at the Humane Society after all the rudeness I left I went to vetmed very nice people there who gave my dog a a normal checkup came out with him told me that his teeth and gums were just fine no signs of parvo his gums looked amazing unlike Ark vet who decided to tell me that my dog's gums were so pale that they were basically positive he had parvo horrible place would not recommend them to anybody and would give them zero Stars if I could absolutely unacceptable to be telling people they should take their dog to the Humane Society and drop them off considering they can't pay the expensive fees that they're charging and just for the update like I said my dog's gums look great he is parvo free just like I told them and I was not charged for a vet visit only medication where I went after I went to Ark vet Ark vet is trash and I wouldn't recommend them to anybody

Dr. Cal and his assistant Erika were very kind and professional. I brought my dog in after having some concerns and the Doctor was very informative and helpful about what’s best for my dogs diet. Erika was very patient and sweet towards my dog Milo, and even followed up with me the day after to make sure he was doing okay. Prices are great and reasonable. I would recommend this Vet to everyone and anyone!

Above and BEYOND! Absolutely the best! We have 3 dogs and will not take them anywhere else! Our Great Dane had surgery yesterday, they gave us updates throughout the day so we knew what to expect. They even stayed past closing to ensure that she was ready to go home. 2 hours after closing, Dr. Haley Burgart and Rain carried our 105 pound dog from the back office to our car! I’ve been to a lot of different vets over the years and none of them have ever given me this level of service! Strong recommendation! Worth every dollar.

Legitimately one of the best experiences out of having to go to an urgent care or emergency vet that I’ve ever had. The front staff was incredibly kind and comforting and knowledgeable and the doctor and his assistant were right on it. Very helpful!! I would highly recommend if you are ever in a situation to need to take your dog to emergency for services that you go here! Just incredible service, incredible help for my dog and she is home,  healing thanks to them!

If you’re looking for a wonderful, loving place to take care of your pup, you have to go here! Dr Rian is very thorough and kind, and incredibly knowledgeable when it comes to dogs! Just moved here and needed a vet for routine care and I couldn’t be happier!

We have never been here before and brought our cat in to see Dr Burgart. Within minutes he realized it was an emergency and sent us directly to the medical hospital. It was very time sensitive and he was wonderful, caring and worked with urgency.

My lil Pug started having an issue with eye. She was having trouble keeping it open, it was watery and I could tell it was really bothering her. I was able to get an appointment for her at ArkVets. It was a very good experience from start to finish... The Vets and the Vet Tech's were all great, very personable. My Puggie had scratched her Cornea. They confirmed it by placing dye in her eye, it adheres to the scratch and then can be seen by shining light in it. It was a significant scratch. She was put on Antibiotics and eyedrops for seven days. We took her back after 7 days to recheck the eye. We are happy to report her eye is all better. I'm so thankful. They are upfront about the cost of service and I was comfortable with what I paid. Very fair!  Everyone was so kind and thought she was so cute. I have agree... I hope she doesn't get anymore injuries, but if she does,  ArkVets will be my first call.

I took my kitten here for his first check up since adopting him and we had a great experience! Shout out to Kayla the vet tech and Dr. Burgart for taking good care of my boy - he really enjoyed his visit 🐈

We had such a wonderful experience bringing our dog Louie here. The staff went above and beyond to help him get better. He is an aggressive dog, especially at the vet, and they figured out solutions to make him feel safe enough to allow an exam/treatment.
I highly recommend Dr. Burgart. She’s patient, kind, and amazing with dogs who are fearful to go to the vet! & Overall we were so impressed with everyone’s communication and kindness.

After once again, leaving the small animal vet clinic on seventh Avenue and Osborne feeling dismissed and frustrated, we went to Arkvets. They are welcoming, kind, and understanding. It seemed just as important to them to get our pets in as it is to us. When we left the small animal clinic, one of their workers told us that we should try our vets because They may be more affordable for us. I think they thought we were homeless or something, no not homeless, we dressed in a hurry, worried about our pets anyway, everyone at arkvets was very accommodating. You meet with the tech, then you meet with the doc, and then the dock write up a treatment plan with options. They in no way try to sell you things. They just put all the options out for you. I couldn’t be more pleased and this is where we will go from now on.

They were absolutely stellar with our dog who is terrified of the vets. The vet took her time with us and our two dogs. She explained all of our options and didn’t pressure us to go with any one option, but made sure we felt educated on all pros and cons. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone.

My two dogs were experiencing bad symptoms of food poisoning. They both were having diarrhea and vomiting. I was worried about my senior poodle dog because he was becoming lethargic and scaring me. It was a Saturday so I had no idea who to call regarding vet care because my vet was closed on Saturday. I called Arc Vet and explained what happened and they let me bring my dog in to be evaluated by the vet. The whole team at the vet clinic were amazing. They explained to me what was wrong with my dog and what was needed and gave him a shot to decrease the vomiting completely as well as fluids. He's now doing wonderful. I would recommend this vet clinic in case of any type of emergencies for your animals in the future.  I definitely will be back if this ever happens again but God forbid it won't happen. Thank you Arc vet for helping us that day

This vet experience was AMAZING! From the outstanding professionalism to the bedside manner of the vets and techs to the treatment and communication, I couldn’t have asked for better service. My pet had to be treated from an attack of another dog and I had visited another clinic (Veterinary Emergency Group - East Camelback) and received abhorrent service, the staff were insensitive to the needs of my pet, and treatment was not discussed with urgency. Total night and day experience compared to ArkVets. Not only will I give them 5 stars but they have a new customer for any future vet needs for my pets! Great job!! 👏🏼
Super nice folks. Took great care of my dog!

“I had an amazing experience with ARKVets! They took Little Su in at the last minute when she was in a lot of pain, even without an appointment. The staff  and Erika was incredibly kind and attentive, and thanks to them, Little Su is feeling so much better now. Highly recommend their compassionate care!
Thank you again!

They made the worst day of our lives as best as they could. They listened to us and were honest about what made sense for our boy. They showed true empathy and compassion and I’m forever grateful to them for helping us send off our wonderful Bandit. Thank you all so so much.

I could not be more grateful or happy with our care from them. They showed compassion for our pet and us.. Unfortunately, our pet was sick for the first time and I had never experienced anything like this before so I was out of my knowledge. They got us in fast to my relief, got the diagnosis and started the treatment right away. I’m am so grateful to have listened to my gut and beyond thankful for them. Their compassion showed every step of the way. Thanks to them now we stand a chance for our sweetheart to feel better.
I highly recommend them for urgent care needed. I am happy and look forward to having them as well for our new Vet moving forward for continued regular vet care.
Had the best experience! Super fast, and everyone was so nice !
They were very informative and friendly. Made us and our baby feel comfortable,  would recommend

I was referred by All Creatures because they could not get us in on a Saturday for a same day appointment. My dog is high anxiety and had major grooming needs and some irritation on her tail and hygiene area. Both Dr. Burgart and Rayne were amazing with her. They were gentle and caring and were able to get her cleaned up without needing full sedation which was recommended to me somewhere else. Dr. Burgart also provided printouts of recommended products and recommendations for groomers who may be able to handle my dog as she has been turned away from every groomer she's been to. I absolutely recommended ArkVets for anyone looking for caring and informative care for their pets.

The team helped ease our worry as our little Roxy was not well but thankfully it looks as though nothing major we did get her some fluids and pro/prebiotics to help her belly … thanks to everyone there that helped us and everyone was so nice and helpful …

Just love this place … Bailey had a recheck after surgery and new bloodwork … they are so thorough and thoughtful… thank you

Amazing and caring ppl. 100% recommend for any of your vet needs. The technician Rain was amazing in going over everything with us and madenit simple to understand. The rest of the staff team are really friendly and very knowledgeable.
Very friendly and helpful.

Dr. Cal and the whole office are fantastic. Quick and easy to make an appointment. Excellent and compassionate care. Would highly recommend to anyone needing care for their furry friend! Dr. Cal in particular is great.

We have been going to Arkvets since last Nov 2024 & they are super awesome there. All the Doctors & Techs are just great, caring,showing love , affection,etc. Terrific service ! We are CAT people & have quite afew !
Thank you for the 5 stars!!

From the office I used to go to in Avondale to the Bell- north Phx office, I’ve been so happy with the care my pets receive at ArkVets! Reasonable prices and quick and caring process with exam and testing. Definitely recommend 😺🐶 …
Excellent service. Knowledgeable and patient care. Scheduling staff are super polite and helpful. I highly recommend Arkvet for pet care.

Took my cat Sugar Demon for an urgent care visit because of something wrong with her eye that was drastically affecting her behavior. I was referred by another vet practice that was already booked and they said ArkVets is excellent-- they are.
I was able to schedule on short notice. The vet, Haley Burgart, was PERFECTLY ON TIME for the appointment. She actually knew what she was talking about and listened to what was wrong. The vet tech Kaylee gave me an estimate for what tests the vet wanted to run and how much each of them would cost. They are informative and don't pressure you into anything. I was able to decide what tests I agreed to and it actually ended up being $20 cheaper than the estimate even though I went with everything Haley recommended (even I could tell the tests were necessary after googling what each of them were-- they weren't pushing anything unecessary like at other vets). Thorough and knowledgeable checkup. My precious Sugar Demon is improving rapidly under Haley's recommended prescription and recommended care routine. After bad experiences with other horrible vets, this place was absolutely wonderful. Will be taking Sugar Demon back for all of her future veterinary needs because they took such good care of my precious baby 💙 10/10 recommend Dr. Haley.
They got my senior dog better with kindness and care. They went out of their way to make sure he was okay
Dr Cal is AMAZING!!! Super thorough, patient and very caring!! He made a tough situation, manageable. 💕 …

I can't thank everyone at ArkVets enough for their kindness and compassion! My little Lucy sustained a large laceration, and after the initial emergency vet did not take total care of the injury, I took her to ArkVets, where they (unfortunately) had to clean up and re-suture/staple the laceration. Lucy was given the needed antibiotic 2-week shot, and the injury looked so much better than before. Even though it was a difficult recovery, she has healed just fine and is back to her frisky self. Thank you again, ArkVets!

My partner and I had such a great experience at Ark Vets. They treated our dog with so much love and care, and it truly meant so much to us! My dog can get nervous with strangers but everyone was so great with him that there were no issues.  Everyone was incredibly kind and welcoming, which made a stressful situation so much easier. I highly recommend them, especially in an emergency. Thank you Ark!

I took my old Golden, Jake, today to the PV location because he had been vomiting all over the house without me knowing ( how did I not hear it?) while I was sleeping and a " thump" woke me up. He was lying in the kitchen and could not walk. They got him in as soon as they could and we're so kind. Jake usually shakes a lot at vets and the Dr. and staff had great energy that actually was very calming to him. From the Vet Tech carrying him onto the gurney to the time another staff carried him out to the car, I was so impressed. And Jake is very heavy. I would highly recommend this practice for your animals needs. I went and bought a harness after to help get him outside to potty. He has vestibular disease and really hope the treatment gives me some more days, weeks, months with him.

Awful awful experience. The tech seemed nice at first. The vet was very rushed with her education on my cats new diagnosis and did not have time to fully explain it (I was the only person in the office at the time so I’m not sure what the rush was). The tech seemed very irritated by my questions (I’m a nurse so I have a decent idea of what to ask, not like I’m asking wild or unrelated questions). She gave me a vibe that she would talk poorly about you after you left.

I got home and they had not told me they had reconstituted the medication so I was concerned it had been tampered with but they were closed when I got home. I had to call a 24 hr vet line to guide me through everything they failed to explain to me about my cat’s diagnosis. They also did not tell me the medication needed to be refrigerated (and it was not labeled on the box or bottle), I had to find that out from the 24 hr vet line as well. Now it is five days later and the medication is concentrated at the bottom of the bottle. I called them to ask why and they said it needs to be shaken daily. This was also not told to me or labeled on the bottle. I work in healthcare and this behavior is lazy and negligent. It’s also infuriating to feel like I can’t take care of my cat in the safest way possible because of their failings. They then told me I need to give him an entire new dose of the antibiotic. I called my primary care vet clinic who confirmed this is not accurate and they (my primary care vet) can actually obtain a urine sample (which this UC was unable to do so) to see if the infection has cleared. The audacity they had to tell me they would CHARGE me for a second antibiotic after all of their failings.

The bottle also only came with seven days worth of antibiotics (15ml in total and 1ml was supposed to be given every 12hrs which equals 7.5 days worth).

The vet also mentioned that my cat “growled” at her and she couldn’t get a urinalysis because of it. He’s eight and an absolute angel and no vet has ever told me that or not been able to obtain important lab work because of this. After this experience it leads me to feel like she made little to no effort. I will never go to this place again and feel like they put my cats health at risk. Thank God for that 24 hr vet line that actually educated me on the diagnosis, what symptoms to look for, how to store the med, and how to best take care of my cat. Also thank goodness for my great primary care vet clinic. Again, as someone who works in healthcare…. This is severely disappointing and neglectful. Do better. Our pets are family and you treated mine like he didn’t matter.
Dr. Stephen DeCamp and staff was excellent At the bell and Route 51 office

Can’t recommend this place enough !!! All the stuff was extremely kind, empathetic, thorough, and delivered exceptional care. My poor dog had an ear infection and I was given very detailed instructions on administering care and am already seeing results in the medications !!
Great service! Awesome team very kind and friendly
Definitely recommend!!!!! Loved how well they took care of my little guy! For sure going back !

ArkVets [Both Location] Bell Rd Phoenix Location] Staff Were [are] Awesome!!
At The Phoenix Location I Brought In My Male Short Hair [Who Was Literally On Death Row] The ON Call Doctor That Day Was Not Only Empathetic To MrThumbs Needs [But He Was Also Comforting To Me [As A Concerned Pet-Parent For My 4Legged Boy] Thumbs *Had A Very-Very Serious Ear Infection Which Caused A Paralysis In His Legs Prohibiting Him To Walk Or Hold His Head Up Straight...He Was Given An Antibiotic Shot [Which Would Last For Roughly 20days [With Perseverance, Love [and] Diligence] Thumbs Was Slowly Able To Come Around...He STILL Has A Slight Walking Issue [Head Probably Permanently] Is Still Cocked To The Side...He Was Given A Green Light At The Paradise ArkVet For A Follow-up [Terrific Dr's There!!]...Because Of *Probably Depth Perception He IS Unable To Jump Up On Anything. For A Free-Roaming Tom I Know It's An Annoying Issue For Him...But Thanks To The ArkVet Dr [and] Staff My MrThumbs IS A Live/Healthy [and] STILL Chasing *Cat Skirts 👀 Hahahaa! THANK YOU ARTVET!!!

From the very first phone call, everyone in reception was super accommodating, scheduling my sick kitty Jade right away- upon arrival, everyone was so friendly and kind, prices were as expected, and they were very honest about the best treatment plan. Dr Williams was knowledgeable and understanding- never pushy. Thank you all for caring for Jade!

EXCELLENT OFFICE PROVIDING EXCEPTIONAL CARE! I had to find a new vet office after the previous one moved too far away. I tried 2 others & wasn’t happy with the hours or care provided at each. When I got a new Cavalier King Charles puppy in March 2025 I took her to ARK on Bell Rd and was so pleased with every step of the appointment. Making it was easy & the office was immaculately clean with a wide open waiting room.

Because her appointment went so well I brought my Malinois in as he needed updated vaccinations. Unfortunately a small mass he had then doubled in size seemingly overnight. We planned excision surgery for 7/3 along with a dental cleaning. Then he strained his back leg & was unable to walk on it the week before. They got him in right away. Without an obvious break or dislocation, in order to save costs they planned to do X-rays under sedation during surgery & prescribed meds to alleviate the inflammation. He just had surgery, the dental and X-rays - all of which went so well.

I couldn’t be happier with the communication, the manner in which recommendations & estimates for both dogs have been presented and the kind, caring way every member of the team has spoken with me. I also believe their prices are very fair and reasonable. I highly recommend them.

The physician and staff were very knowledgeable and compassionate. They took the utmost care of my buddy Mickey. They didn't force treatment on us. They gave a diagnosis and potential prognosis along with a transparent treatment plan and cost. My cat was treated with minimal cost, and hopefully, that will help him feel better. If not, we are most certainly going back. I love the staff here! Mickey was the ultimate judge. He didn't argue. He was chatting and purring the whole time.
Bella wasn't feeling well.  She better now
Trust in God...It's good place
Ready to take care of your pet immediately! Very thankful
Quality care during every step, you can tell they truly want the best for your pet without breaking your bank.

Came here for the first time in a panic because my typical vet was fully booked up and they helped me and my baby get in and out with ease! Left feeling so much better and taken care of thanks to the three ladies there who helped us out, all very kind, informative, and caring which is what you need from a good vet!

My cat was given an application between her shoulder blades for pain anti-flamatory. Once home, she vomited up foam nonstop for over an hour. They were pretty much indifferent and detached from my issue. I later find out Buprenorphine (Zorbium) Transfermal is under scrutiny for killing cats. I was not given this information. The foaming at the mouth, to me, indicates poisoning. I am very unhappy with this clinic. Never again.

They were absolutely amazing! The vet and the entire team all were very compassionate and took care of my baby and helped out with funding some of his procedure. I came in with a very tricky injury and the vet did everything to make sure to find the source and get him all fixed up! Thank you so much for everything diesel was taken care of and came home a very happy boy despite how his day went they treated him like he was their own pup you all are very appreciated!!!! 🖤

I brought my dog Tank there due to a swollen leg. They made me feel comfortable and eased my concerns. They didn’t pressure me into doing anything other than taking care of the issue at hand! The office was extremely clean and the staff were very friendly and personable! I would highly recommend this veterinarian’s office!!
💛 Thank you for your feedback …

This is the 3rd time I've visited ArkVets and I must say that our furbabies are always treated with the utmost quality care!!  If you are looking for a vet, do not hesitate to call them.  If you get the chance to speak to Cathleen, she's the absolute BEST!!! She truly cares about the animals and their parents!!!! Cathleen A. You are the best!!!!  Wouldn't dare think about going anywhere else for my furbabies!!!!

OMG the care we received was incredible!! Since we came from the east coast, it's been a challenge to find a veterinarian who actually cares. Until now!!! They go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and treat your animal with compassion!!! Only place to take your animal!!!! Finally found a home!!!! Thank you for everything!!!

Sincerely,

Wilma
